name: Ahrefs
description_en:
Ahrefs combines a search and backlink database with keyword research, technical audits, manually tracked rankings and AI visibility monitoring. Its current platform also includes reporting, analytics and social tools, with separate allowances and add-ons. Ahrefs Free is the renamed Webmaster Tools account and provides continuing limited access; it is not a timed full-suite trial.

A useful evaluation follows one defined website and market through evidence gathering, an audit and a recurring measurement panel. Site Explorer estimates, a configured Rank Tracker panel, a Site Audit crawl and Brand Radar answers have different origins and timing. Keep those distinctions in the report, then assess proposed changes against the actual website. Public documentation was reviewed without signing up, crawling, connecting data or deploying changes.
description_zh:
Ahrefs 将搜索及外链数据库与关键词研究、技术审计、手动配置排名跟踪及 AI 可见性监控结合。当前平台还含报告、分析及社交工具，各有独立额度或附加项。Ahrefs Free 是更名后的 Webmaster Tools 账户，提供持续有限访问，不是限时全套试用。

适合评估的流程是围绕一个明确网站及市场收集证据、审计并建立持续测量面板。Site Explorer 估算、配置的 Rank Tracker 面板、Site Audit 抓取及 Brand Radar 回答的来源和时间不同，应在报告中保留区别，再结合真实网站评估修改。本条实读公开文档，未注册、抓取、连数据或部署。

core_features.explanation_en: Site Explorer exposes database observations and modeled traffic for a target.
core_features.explanation_zh: Site Explorer 展示目标的数据库观察及模型流量。

core_features.explanation_en: Rank Tracker monitors selected keywords and locations within project capacity.
core_features.explanation_zh: Rank Tracker 在项目容量内监控所选词及位置。

core_features.explanation_en: Site Audit uses its own crawler and configurable scope.
core_features.explanation_zh: Site Audit 使用独立爬虫及可配范围。

core_features.explanation_en: Brand Radar distinguishes database discovery from custom tracked prompts.
core_features.explanation_zh: Brand Radar 区分数据库发现及自定义跟踪提示词。

en: Investigate competitor search/link observations with explicit estimate labels.
Audit an owned website and verify a focused correction against equivalent crawls.
Maintain a scoped ranking/AI panel and report its data origins.
zh: 明确估算标签后调查竞品搜索／外链观察。
审自有网站，以等价抓取验证聚焦修复。
维护限定排名／AI 面板并报告数据来源。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Verify the project scope and choose a representative crawl.
steps.zh: 核项目范围并选代表抓取。

steps.en: Inspect estimated traffic, KD freshness and actual referring pages.
steps.zh: 查估算流量、KD 时效及真实引用页。

steps.en: Set a small keyword/location panel and record history provenance.
steps.zh: 设置小型词／位置面板并记历史来源。

steps.en: Separate database and custom AI datasets and inspect check use.
steps.zh: 区分数据库及自定义 AI 数据集并查检查用量。

steps.en: Review member sharing and API-key limits before collaboration.
steps.zh: 协作前审成员分享及 API key 限额。

items.en: Site Audit recrawls do not refresh Site Explorer.
items.zh: Site Audit 重抓不刷新 Site Explorer。

items.en: A boost downgrade leaves already published patches active.
items.zh: 附加档降低后，已发布补丁仍生效。

items.en: Custom and database AI answers can be mixed unless Dataset is selected.
items.zh: 未选 Dataset 时可混合自定义及数据库 AI 回答。

items.en: Included report credits do not eliminate crawl, rank or API limits.
items.zh: 包含的报告积分不取消抓取、排名或 API 上限。

supported_languages.scope_en: Documented interface languages, not a guarantee of every data field or export language.
supported_languages.scope_zh: 文档列界面语言，不保证全部数据字段或导出语言。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current cards: Starter $29/month, Lite $129, Standard $249, Advanced $449; Enterprise $1,499/month requires annual commitment. Annual advertises up to 17% savings; exact checkout currency/tax/annual totals not verified. Lite/Standard/Advanced each include one user, 750/2,000/5,000 tracked keywords and 150/300/600 AI checks. Brand Radar database access starts $199/month; custom packages $50/$100/$250 have separate check limits and overage. Report Builder add-on $99/month; Project Boost Pro/Max $20/$200 per project/month. Free is continuing limited access. No general refund; unused monthly-service requests may be declined after material activity. No normalized price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前卡片 Starter $29／月、Lite $129、Standard $249、Advanced $449，Enterprise 每月 $1,499 需年承诺。年付宣传最多省 17%，准确结账币种／税／年总额未核。Lite／Standard／Advanced 各含一用户、750／2,000／5,000 跟踪词及 150／300／600 AI 检查。Brand Radar 数据库访问 $199／月起，自定义包 $50／$100／$250 各有检查上限及超额。报告附加项 $99／月，Project Boost Pro／Max 每项目每月 $20／$200。Free 为持续有限访问，通常不退款，月订阅未用服务的申请可因实质活动被拒。不设标准化价。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Permanent free access still requires the right website scope
sections.title_zh: 持续免费访问仍需正确网站范围
sections.en: Ahrefs Free offers limited continuing access without a card. Site Explorer, Site Audit and Web Analytics require verified ownership; other listed tools have different requirements. Current free limits include five thousand monthly crawl credits per verified project and one thousand visible backlink/keyword rows at once. Social Media Manager unlimited access is explicitly beta. Ownership can use GSC, DNS, a file or a tag; GSC must match the project mode and verification evidence must remain available. Editorial start: verify the exact website scope and inspect its limits before treating free access as competitor-wide or full-history research.
sections.zh: Ahrefs Free 提供免卡持续有限访问。Site Explorer、Site Audit 及 Web Analytics 需所有权验证，其他工具条件不同。当前免费列每已验证项目每月五千抓取额度、一次可见一千外链／关键词行；社交管理不限访问明确为 beta。所有权可用 GSC、DNS、文件或标签，GSC 需匹配项目模式，验证证据须持续保留。编辑入门：先核准确网站范围及额度，不能将免费访问视作全竞品或完整历史研究。

sections.title_en: Estimated traffic and relative link strength answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 流量估算及相对外链强度回答不同问题
sections.en: Organic Traffic estimates monthly Google clicks from ranking positions, search volume and estimated CTR. Weekly and monthly views average daily estimates rather than summing daily visitors. DR is a relative domain backlink score; UR applies to individual pages. DR can fall as other domains change even without a lost backlink. Editorial competitor review: retain target scope, country, dates and database context, inspect referring pages and relevant content, and compare owned-site performance with first-party measurements. A high DR does not alone establish link quality, and a traffic estimate is neither recorded sessions nor a verified competitor revenue figure.
sections.zh: Organic Traffic 按排名、搜索量及估计 CTR 估每月 Google 点击，周／月视图平均每日估值，不是累加每日访客。DR 是相对域级外链分数，UR 对应单页；即使没丢外链，其他域变化也可使 DR 降低。编辑竞品检查：保留目标范围、国家、日期及数据库语境，审引用页及相关内容，自有站用第一方测量核表现。高 DR 本身不确定外链质量，流量估算既非记录会话，也非已核竞品收入。

sections.title_en: KD is a backlink filter with a freshness limit
sections.title_zh: KD 是带时效限制的外链筛选
sections.en: Keyword Difficulty estimates top-ten Google ranking difficulty on a zero-to-hundred scale using referring domains of the leading organic pages. It excludes on-page SEO factors. Grey KD indicates a SERP not refreshed for at least twenty days; refreshing depends on available SERP-update allowance. Automatic refresh frequency varies with keyword importance/volume rather than a guaranteed schedule. Editorial keyword shortlist: use KD as one filter, then inspect actual result intent, page formats and business relevance. A low score does not establish that a new page will rank, and an old score should not silently become a current competitive assessment.
sections.zh: Keyword Difficulty 用前列自然页引用域，在零至百分估 Google 前十排名难度，排除页面内 SEO 因素。灰色 KD 表示 SERP 至少二十天未刷新，刷新依可用 SERP 更新额度；自动频率随词重要性／搜索量不同，没有保证日程。编辑关键词短名单：KD 仅作一项筛选，再审真实结果意图、页面形式及业务相关。低分不能确定新页会排名，旧分也不能默认为当前竞争判断。

sections.title_en: Tracked rankings and imported history retain different origins
sections.title_zh: 跟踪排名及导入历史保留不同来源
sections.en: One tracked keyword is a keyword/location/project combination, shared against account capacity. Default updates are weekly; excess terms can freeze, and each project has a ten-thousand-term cap. Site Explorer discovers keywords independently at country/desktop scope with variable refresh timing. Rank Tracker can import its earlier observations, but only country-level desktop history is available; very low-volume terms may lack history. After tracking begins, future observations come from Rank Tracker. Editorial trend review: mark the imported-history boundary, location and device rather than reading a longer chart as a continuous city/mobile measurement. A frozen keyword is not fresh evidence of a stable rank.
sections.zh: 一个跟踪词按关键词／位置／项目组合计算，共用账户容量，默认周更，超额可冻结，单项目最多一万词。Site Explorer 独立发现国家／桌面词，刷新时点不同。Rank Tracker 可导较早观察，但仅国家级桌面历史，低量词可无历史；开始跟踪后的观察来自 Rank Tracker。编辑趋势检查：标导入边界、位置及设备，不能将长图读为连续城市／移动测量。冻结词不是排名稳定的新证据。

sections.title_en: Audit settings change future crawls, not the research database
sections.title_zh: 审计设置改变后续抓取，不改变研究数据库
sections.en: Seed URLs, include/exclude expressions, JavaScript rendering, limits and scheduling determine the crawl. Settings changes affect new crawls, not ongoing or historical ones. Site Audit uses AhrefsSiteAudit; recrawling does not update Site Explorer’s separate AhrefsBot database. Only internal HTTP-200 HTML pages consume crawl credits, so total crawled URLs can exceed the credited-page cap. Health Score is the proportion of crawled internal URLs without Error issues; Warnings and Notices do not lower it. Editorial fix review: preserve crawl scope and issue configuration, inspect affected URLs and compare equivalent crawls. A higher score after scope or rule changes does not by itself prove the website improved.
sections.zh: 种子 URL、包含／排除表达式、JS 渲染、限额及计划决定抓取。设置变更影响新抓取，不改进行中或历史结果。Site Audit 用 AhrefsSiteAudit，重抓不更新独立 AhrefsBot 的 Site Explorer 数据库。仅内部 HTTP 200 HTML 消耗抓取额度，因此总 URL 可超过计费页面上限。Health Score 是已抓内部 URL 中无 Error 的比例，Warning／Notice 不降分。编辑修复检查：保留范围及规则，审受影响 URL、比等价抓取；改范围或规则后分数上升不能独立证明网站改善。

sections.title_en: Patches can publish live changes and survive a boost downgrade
sections.title_zh: Patches 可发布线上修改，降附加档后仍可保留
sections.en: The read guide supports titles and meta descriptions; other fields are described as planned. Drafts autosave, publishing makes changes live and unpublishing undoes a patch. JavaScript deployment affects rendered pages; a Cloudflare worker can alter server HTML. Publishing requires verified ownership, configured deployment, an eligible Project Boost and user 2FA. Any project-access user can draft. Deleting the project unpublishes its patches, while losing the eligible boost prevents new publication but leaves existing patches active. Editorial handoff: inspect draft history and actual output, retain the original value and choose an explicit unpublish or source-code change. No deployment was performed.
sections.zh: 实读指南支持标题及 meta description，其他字段列为计划。草稿自动存，发布使修改上线，取消发布撤销。JS 部署影响渲染页，Cloudflare worker 可改服务端 HTML。发布需验证所有权、部署设置、合格 Project Boost 及用户 2FA；获项目访问者皆可起草。删项目会取消其补丁，失去合格附加档只阻新发布，已有补丁仍生效。编辑交接：审历史及真实输出，保留原值并明确取消发布或改源码。本研究未部署。

sections.title_en: Database AI visibility differs from a customer’s answer
sections.title_zh: 数据库 AI 可见性不同于某位客户的回答
sections.en: Brand Radar searches a collected response corpus and allows grouped brand names/domains, filters and saved reports. The guide describes search-backed prompts and different refresh cadences: database chatbot answers monthly, while other indexes differ. Custom prompts begin when added. Grok collection is currently paused; the overview newly mentions Claude custom-only at an eight-check multiplier, while the setup guide does not list it. Editorial visibility review: retain dataset, platform, date and aliases and inspect source responses. A citation does not establish training provenance, endorsement or a visit. Conflicting platform lists and changing corpus counts remain documentation limits, not an invented uniform coverage guarantee.
sections.zh: Brand Radar 检索已采回答，可组合品牌名／域、筛选及保存报告。指南描述以搜索问题为基础的提示词及不同更新周期：数据库聊天回答月更，其他索引不同，自定义提示词从加入后开始。当前 Grok 采集暂停，概览新增 Claude 仅自定义、八倍检查用量，设置指南却未列。编辑可见性检查：保留数据集、平台、日期及别名并审源回答。引用不能确定训练来源、背书或访问。平台表冲突及不断变动语料规模仍是文档限制，不编造统一覆盖保证。

sections.title_en: A prompt check budget multiplies by platform, location and frequency
sections.title_zh: 提示词检查预算随平台、位置及频率相乘
sections.en: Custom tracking starts from a saved Brand Radar report. Choose prompts, platforms, locations and monthly/weekly/daily cadence, then inspect estimated checks before adding. One normal check is one execution/platform/location; reducing frequency expands possible panel size. With PAYG disabled, exhausted checks stop until the next billing month. New answers can take up to twenty-four hours; deletion is irreversible. The Dataset filter separates custom and Ahrefs prompts, while leaving it unselected mixes both. Editorial monitoring: keep a small stable panel and record dataset selection before comparisons. An included check allowance is not unlimited daily tracking, and query generation is not observed user demand.
sections.zh: 自定义跟踪从保存的 Brand Radar 报告开始，选词、平台、位置及月／周／日周期，追加前审预计检查数。普通一次检查按执行／平台／位置计，降频可扩大面板。PAYG 关闭且额度耗尽会停到下个计费月，新回答可需二十四小时，删除不可逆。Dataset 筛选区分自定义与 Ahrefs 提示词，未选会混两者。编辑监控：维持小型稳定面板，比对前记数据集选择。附送检查不等于不限日更，生成查询也不是观察到的用户需求。

sections.title_en: Unlimited report credits do not remove every meter
sections.title_zh: 不限报告积分不取消其他计量
sections.en: The credit-plan guide applies to Starter, Lite and older subscriptions, while current Standard and above use unlimited fair usage for active users. In credit plans, opening reports, filtering and requesting more data can consume credits; Site Audit and Rank Tracker use separate meters. Additional users can accrue usage-based charges, and enabled PAYG buys extra capacity. Deleting a user before period-end does not erase incurred activity charges. Editorial budget: check the actual plan generation, per-user limit and each meter before inviting a team or automating research. A current Standard allowance should not be projected onto a legacy Standard subscription.
sections.zh: 积分指南适用 Starter、Lite 及旧订阅，当前 Standard 以上对活跃用户用不限公平使用。积分档打开报告、筛选及请求更多数据可耗积分，Site Audit 及 Rank Tracker 独立计量。额外用户可产生按用量费用，启用 PAYG 会购买额外容量，期末前删用户不抹去已发生费用。编辑预算：邀请团队或自动化前核真实套餐代际、逐人上限及各计量，不能将当前 Standard 权益套到旧 Standard。

sections.title_en: MCP uses API units, including fields only used as filters
sections.title_zh: MCP 消耗 API 单位，筛选专用字段也计费
sections.en: Hosted MCP supports Lite and above with consent and an MCP-scoped key. OAuth-created keys default to a two-hundred-thousand-unit monthly cap, changeable by workspace Admins; the workspace cap still applies. Standard API request cost is the larger of fifty units or returned rows times unique-field cost, including fields used only in filtering or sorting. Cache hits and documented free endpoints differ. Editorial automation: request only needed fields, inspect endpoint rules and response consumption headers, and distinguish a per-request row cap from monthly budget. Use the supported public API for scripts; the external MCP endpoint is not a general-purpose programmatic API.
sections.zh: 托管 MCP 支持 Lite 以上，经同意及 MCP 范围 key 连接。OAuth 新 key 默认每月二十万单位上限，Admin 可调，仍受工作区上限。标准 API 成本取五十单位或返回行数乘唯一字段成本的较大值，仅用于筛选／排序的字段也计入。缓存命中及文档列免费端点另算。编辑自动化：只请求所需字段、查端点规则及响应消耗头，区分每次行数上限及月预算。脚本使用支持的公共 API，外部 MCP 端点不是通用程序 API。

sections.title_en: Member access includes objects shared with everyone
sections.title_zh: Member 可访问共享给全员的对象
sections.en: Members see explicitly shared objects and those shared with All workspace members, and can create objects. Admins see everything and manage settings, subscriptions and users. Enterprise Guests see only explicitly shared objects. After accepting an invitation, a user must switch from their own workspace to the invited workspace; otherwise the visible plan or data may differ. Editorial client collaboration: inspect object sharing as well as role before inviting someone. A Member is not equivalent to a narrowly isolated client portal, and pending invitations should not be confused with accepted access.
sections.zh: Member 可见明确共享及 All workspace members 对象，并可创建对象。Admin 可见全部、管理设置／订阅／成员，Enterprise Guest 仅见明确共享对象。接受邀请后需从个人切到受邀工作区，否则所见套餐／数据可不同。编辑客户协作：邀请前同时核对象分享及角色。Member 不等于严格隔离的客户门户，待接受邀请也不能混为已获访问。

sections.title_en: Report capacity and cancellation need separate checks
sections.title_zh: 报告容量及取消需要分别核查
sections.en: Report Builder configures a target and chart/table widgets, then offers Print to PDF. Its older guide says one report/five widgets and only Site Explorer/Rank Tracker; current pricing lists larger included capacities and the Brand Radar guide documents its widgets too. Verify the effective account rather than treating the older guide as a current exhaustive list. Cancellation takes effect at paid-period end and switches to Free; removing the saved card follows that downgrade. Account deletion requires support confirmation and settled outstanding bills. Editorial exit: export needed reports, inspect all subscriptions and confirm dates; canceling renewal is not immediate account deletion.
sections.zh: Report Builder 配目标及图表／表格组件，可 Print to PDF。较旧指南列一报告／五组件、仅 Site Explorer／Rank Tracker，当前价格却列更高包含量，Brand Radar 指南也记录其组件，需核有效账户，不能将旧指南当当前穷尽列表。取消在已付期末生效并切 Free，之后才能删保存卡。删账户需支持确认且结清欠款。编辑退出：导所需报告、查全部订阅及日期，取消续订不等于立即删账户。

seo.title_en: Ahrefs: search data, audit scope and AI monitoring limits
seo.title_zh: Ahrefs：搜索数据、审计范围及 AI 监控限制
seo.description_en: Review Ahrefs traffic estimates, keyword history, crawl scope, live patches, Brand Radar datasets and usage meters.
seo.description_zh: 核 Ahrefs 流量估算、关键词历史、抓取范围、线上补丁、Brand Radar 数据集及用量。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate Ahrefs SEO research, site audit and AI visibility workflows
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: Report Builder guide capacities/coverage lag current pricing and Brand Radar documentation; actual scheduling/sharing enforcement not tested.
research_gaps.zh: Report Builder 指南容量／覆盖落后于当前价格及 Brand Radar 文档，真实调度／分享强制规则未测。

research_gaps.en: Brand Radar corpus counts and platform lists differ across current pages; Claude is custom-only in overview but omitted from setup list, and Grok collection is paused.
research_gaps.zh: 当前页 Brand Radar 语料数及平台表不同，概览 Claude 仅自定义但设置表未列，Grok 采集暂停。

research_gaps.en: Regional checkout currency, taxes, historical retention, complete new social/analytics/AI tool operations and source-code licence not fully verified.
research_gaps.zh: 地区结账币种、税、历史保留、全部新增社交／分析／AI 工具操作及源码许可未全面核。

research_gaps.en: No purchase, source authorization, crawl, prompt query, API call, invitation, patch deployment, report export or account cancellation executed; vendor quality and business outcomes unmeasured.
research_gaps.zh: 未购买、授权源、抓取、查询提示词、API 请求、邀请、部署补丁、导报告或取消账户，供应商质量及业务效果未测。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
